Lemma
[Criterion for long-time existence under bounded scalar curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0063 1. ch28:28.16\group Singularity Models

If a finite-time singular flow has no Ricci-flat singularity model, then $\sup _{\mathcal M\times [0,T)}R=\infty $.
